newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industrial production up in September-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industrial production up in September-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in September rose 1.3 percent from August and 7.7 percent on September 1995, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The IBGE said it was becoming increasingly clear that industrial output was picking up again.
However, industrial production in the January-to-September period fell 0.5 percent, compared with a 1.5 percent fall in the January-to-August period, the IBGE said.
In the 12 months to September, industrial output fell 1.9 percent.

Output in September increased in 10 of the 20 industrial sectors covered in the IBGE survey, with transport materials up 5.1 percent, electrical and communications material rising 2.9 percent, metals up 2.6 percent and mineral extraction up 6.3 percent.
Output of durable consumer goods expanded the most in September at 5.1 percent, reaching record levels of production, while output of semi- and non-durable goods fell 1.1 percent, the IBGE said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
